name: ai-stack-mapper
description: Map every LLM, MCP server, Tool and Agent framework used across your codebase.

commands.title: AI Stack: Set LLM API Key
AI Stack: Clear LLM API Key

aiStackMapper.pythonPath.description: Path to the Python 3 interpreter used to run the scanner (must be 3.8+).

aiStackMapper.scanOnSave.description: Automatically re-scan (debounced) when a relevant file is saved.

aiStackMapper.enrichWithLLM.description: Optional: ask an LLM to infer each component's likely purpose/usage/expected output. OFF by default. Requires an API key set via 'AI Stack: Set LLM API Key'. Sends only code-derived context (file:line, enclosing function/class name + docstring, prompt text) to the configured LLM endpoint -- never full source files or secret values.

aiStackMapper.llmBaseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible chat-completions base URL for optional AI enrichment and risk controls (default: https://api.openai.com/v1). Point this at a self-hosted/on-prem endpoint (vLLM, Ollama, internal Azure OpenAI, LiteLLM proxy) to avoid sending code context to a public cloud LLM.

aiStackMapper.llmModel.description: Model name to request for optional AI enrichment and risk controls.

aiStackMapper.riskUseLLM.description: Optional: use the configured LLM to generate controls/remediation for statically detected code assessment risks. OFF by default.

aiStackMapper.riskFailOn.description: Severity threshold used in the generated AI risk report status.
